ateret-zekenim/1:_.he: ותיניקות של בית רבן כו'. ואפילו דברי רעים נמי אסור ללמוד עמהם משום שהתינוקות אינם מבינים בטוב מה שמוציאים בפיהם ועיקר שמחתם בזה שיודעים מה שהם אומרים ע"כ אין לחלק בהן בין דברי נחמות לדברים רעים ע"כ אם התינוק מבין מה שהוא אומר מותר ללמוד עמו דברים רעים: יש מי שכתב שאין לברך בט"ב וי"כ שעשית לי כל צרכי מפני שאז אסור בנעילת הסנדל [לחם מן השמים] ואם הלך לפני השר ויש הקפד' עליו אם ילך בלא מנעלים יתן עפר במנעלים וילך (מרדכי סוף מ"ק) ובכל מקום שצריך לילך במנעלים יעשה כן: והמנהג שהנשים רוחצות ראשן ממנחה ולמעלה וזקני' הראשוני' הנהיגו זה ועשו סמך לדבר על מה שאמרו באגד' כי משיח נולד בט"ב וצריך לעשות זכר לגואל ולנחמם כדי שלא יתיאשו מן הגאולה וזהו דוקא לנשים לפי שהמה חלושים להאמין בנחמות לפי שאין יודעין ספר לפיכך צריכין חיזוק (כל בו) ומשא ומתן אם הוא דבר האבוד הוא מותר כדרך שהתירו במועד (תשוב' הרשב"א סי' תקנ"א) וכל מלאכה אפי' היא של הדיוט אפילו אינה של טורח אם יש בה קצת שמשתעשע בה אין לעשות בט"ב שעל ידי כך מבטל מעינוי (ת"ה סי' קנ"ג):
ateret-zekenim/1:_.en: and infants of Beit Raban etc. And even bad words are not allowed to be learned with them, because the babies do not understand well what they put out of their mouths, and their greatest joy is that they know what they are saying, therefore, they should not be divided between words of comfort and bad things, because if the baby understands what he is saying, it is permissible to learn bad things with him: there is someone who wrote that one should not bless in the Gemara and that you have done all my needs because then it is forbidden to wear sandals [Bread from Heaven] and if he went before the minister, and there is a need to be strict about him if he goes without shoes He shall put dust in his shoes and walk (Mordechai end of MK) and wherever it is necessary to walk in shoes, he shall do so: and the custom that women wash their heads from the offering and up and the elders of the 'primary' led this and made a trust to speak of what was said in the Gemara that the Messiah was born in the Gemara and it is necessary to remember the Redeemer and to be comforted so that they do not despair of the redemption and this is precisely for women according to which they are weak to believe in consolations according to those who do not know the book therefore they need strengthening (every In it) and negotiation if it is a lost matter, it is permitted as a way that was permitted at the time (Tashub' Hashaba 3:1519) and any work that belongs to a layman is not even of a troublemaker if there is something in it that amuses itself in it.

DHTZ the most ka kashya liya from Dammer there is no consumption, it means my imagination in the patient who is provided if there is danger in the matter and the DAT said Imud Dasma according to my opinion' he will be at risk because of the fast, but they feed him immediately and aha kashya liya to the 16th dam says he needs I if so from KML DAT he estimates that after all Efi' when a doctor assesses him and says there is no danger in him if a doctor says that it is a food and a patient says it is necessary Shumein for the patient and the 16th case law for him danger does not belong Omed 11 Dai Meiri from a patient that does not belong in him danger and there is no doubt about the fact that there is certainly no place for danger so does not belong Omed and so meiri that there is doubt here as to whether he will risk such a falsification DAT DAT DAF I estimate Dafi' Amdoho doesn't care about him because DAD Omad should also not be interpreted simply and DAT Omad does not say she should If he were to estimate him that there was no danger in him, it would be forbidden, but what is the prohibition of Dauriyta? What is the prohibition for me? Why should we not feed him, and if they say that he will not risk, we will not feed him? Since it does not say that we should, and the same applies to the patient as in the third chapter, for if we had known that there was no danger, we would not have fed him. They feed him even though he does not say that it is necessary since this is a threat, but there is a doubt that he will take a risk, we should not make it worse per the estimate that he will not take a risk since the DTAB is Durbanan and for this matter Shafir belongs to the division between Durbanan and Daurita.
